_comment: Project-scope .mcp.json for working on pipelinekit. Serena requires uvx; install via 'pip install uv' or 'brew install uv'. The git+https ref is pinned to a known-good commit SHA (5e4f5cd173c7ff3eed37ee3f1de6c266b937c5dc); refresh it per the _serena_pin_note in .mcp.json.template. The MCP entrypoint is 'serena start-mcp-server --context claude-code'. This project-scope .mcp.json takes precedence over the global user-scope serena registration written by scripts/install.sh (provision_serena_mcp), so contributors get the pinned uvx form with the Claude Code tool subset automatically; the global form (bare 'serena' binary via --project-from-cwd) applies in repos without this file.
_security_note: This serena ref is pinned to a specific commit SHA; an unpinned git+https ref (or rolling 'main') would allow upstream takeover to execute arbitrary code via uvx. Bump it together with SERENA_REF in scripts/install.sh and .mcp.json.template.

_mcpServers_alt._comment: Alternative LSP-backed semantic-retrieval MCP. claude-context complements serena: serena does LSP symbolic nav (Go-to-Def, Find-References); claude-context does AST-chunked semantic RAG. Move into 'mcpServers' (and add credentials per its docs) to enable.
